description: This Dart file defines a custom Flutter theme called OceanProfessionalTheme, configuring various UI components such as AppBar, Card, FloatingActionButton, InputDecoration, Chip, Divider, and page transitions with specific styling options for a consistent look and feel.

classes.name: ThemeData
classes.description: A Flutter class that holds the color, typography, and shape which can be applied throughout the app to ensure a consistent theme.

classes.name: ColorScheme
classes.description: Defines the color palette for the overall application theme, including primary, secondary, error, surface, and background colors.

classes.name: AppBarTheme
classes.description: Configures the appearance of AppBars in the app, such as elevation, background color, and title alignment.

classes.name: CardTheme
classes.description: Sets the visual properties for Card widgets, including color, shape, elevation, and shadow.

classes.name: FloatingActionButtonThemeData
classes.description: Defines the theme attributes for FloatingActionButton widgets, such as background and foreground colors.

classes.name: InputDecorationTheme
classes.description: Customizes the appearance of input fields, including borders, padding, fill color, and focus styles.

classes.name: ChipThemeData
classes.description: Specifies styling for Chip widgets, including background color, shape, label style, and padding.

classes.name: DividerThemeData
classes.description: Sets divider line Properties such as color, thickness, and spacing.

classes.name: PageTransitionsTheme
classes.description: Configures page transition animations for different platforms.

methods.name: buildOceanProfessionalTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a customized Flutter ThemeData object with specified design tokens and component themes for a modern, professional aesthetic.
